not_oracles: sha256 of a report without raw bytes
witness_requirements: opens files of the effect directory itself
reports effective uid, own source hash, run id
oracle.external_verifier: tests/verify_bundle.py (third implementation, recomputes from RAW bytes)

trust_root.os_controller: Arena/E2B ephemeral container platform (hostname e2b.local, per-session recycle observed)
trust_root.privileged_actor: human user, conditional authorization for minimal root provisioning in this ephemeral container only
trust_root.external_anchor: git push of this freeze commit BEFORE tests (GitHub receive timestamp)

admin_rules: test accounts only, no admin privileges
no modification of /home, user data, existing repos, secrets, system configs
no recursive deletion, no global chmod, no external installation, no public deployment
every privileged command journaled with stdout/stderr/exit code
stop immediately if isolation or permissions cannot be verified

clock.note: horloge figée -> marqueurs pré-calculables avant exécution

precomputed_marker_sha256.note: valeurs calculées par tests/run_v3e_tribunal.py AVANT toute exécution et écrites dans RAW_EVIDENCE/precomputed_expectations.json ; le témoin les compare aux octets observés

negative_cases: X1 unknown field in body (identity/system_eval) -> 422, no marker
X2 forbidden action admin.delete (validly signed) -> 4xx, no marker
X3 wrong signing key -> 4xx, no marker
X4 tampered nonce after signature -> 4xx, no marker
X5 replayed signature of consumed permit -> 4xx, no second marker
X6 resource outside allowlist -> 4xx, no marker

crash_points.C1: AEGIS_FAULT=before_consume_commit -> NO_CONSUMPTION; retry may succeed exactly once

control_families.A: permission ALLOW -> exactly one unique marker, confirmed by independent witness
control_families.C: replay/restart/concurrency -> never a second effect (same nonce, 8 concurrent, restart)
control_families.D: direct access by agent uid -> EACCES on effect dir, registry and config writes (BLOCKED_ENVIRONMENT if provisioning not authorized)
control_families.E: crash C1-C4 -> composite states justified, witnessed independently

attestation_negative_controls.V1: alter one marker byte -> witness must refuse
attestation_negative_controls.V2: substitute witness report -> external verifier must refuse
attestation_negative_controls.V3: earlier timestamp/chain head rollback -> must not validate by simple hash; compare independent anchors
attestation_negative_controls.V4: old signed permit + old/rebuilt registry -> no second effect; compare independent anchors (marker O_EXCL floor, receipts)
attestation_negative_controls.V5: witness unavailable -> UNKNOWN/HOLD, never CONFIRMED by default

durability_rules: POWER_LOSS_DURABILITY stays NOT_EXECUTED without a power-cut rig
refusal_criteria: no PASS without executed command and raw receipt
